title: artgate Phase 4: diffusion route, 3D cell, full vector coverage, and the margin gate
objective: Close the remaining bake-off cells - route (b) local diffusion on the 3090, route (d) 3D via headless Blender, and the other seven vector subjects - so all four routes are measured on the same twelve subjects. The phase's real outcome was a missing gate: diffusion output passed everything while being unusable, which forced MARGIN_TOO_SMALL into existence and inverted the decision table.
acceptance_criteria: diffusers runs on the GPU in the isolated uv 3.12 venv, with model gating status verified at execution time rather than recalled.
Route (b) generates all twelve subjects locally with no gated download on the critical path.
Route (d) covers all twelve vector subjects, making its number comparable to route (a)'s.
Route (d) 3D renders via headless Blender, with a phantom-success guard: Blender exits 0 even when its embedded script raises.
A margin gate rejects full-bleed assets, because an item icon must be a sprite with a silhouette, not a square tile.
Every gate failure observed on real output is verified as a true positive before any threshold or shape is changed.
100% branch coverage, zero lint suppressions, all pre-commit hooks pass.
out_of_scope: Deciding which route WINS. That needs the human contact-sheet verdicts, which are the user's call; this change only produces the machine column and the sheets.

A production matting solution for diffusion output. The flood-fill background removal demonstrated recoverability but visibly damages the art, and is reported as inadequate rather than shipped as the answer.
Modelling all twelve subjects in 3D. Five meshes answer whether render->finish clears the gates; twelve would be modelling work, not a route comparison.
Gated model families (FLUX.1-dev, SD3.x). Verified gated at execution time and deliberately kept off the critical path.
verifier: python -m pytest python_pkg/artgate/tests/ --cov=python_pkg.artgate --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100 (114 tests, 100% branch on 13 modules); pre-commit run over all artgate files; plus end-to-end generation and gating of all four routes against styles/pixel_icon.toml, with each observed failure traced to a specific measurable defect.
